claim: The new name `Submodule.coe_starProjection_eq_isComplProjection` writes `Submodule.IsCompl.projection` as `isComplProjection`. Everywhere else the library writes it `isCompl_projection`: `IsIdempotentElem.eq_isCompl_projection`, `isIdempotentElem_iff_eq_isCompl_projection_range_ker` and `linearProjOfIsCompl_isCompl_projection` in Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/Projection.lean, and the old name of this very lemma. The PR is meant to make the names consistent, but it leaves this lemma spelling the same definition differently from all of its siblings.
requested_change: Keep the existing spelling of the right-hand side and rename the lemma to `Submodule.coe_starProjection_eq_isCompl_projection`, pointing the 2025-12-26 deprecated alias `starProjection_coe_eq_isCompl_projection` and the two uses in Mathlib/Analysis/InnerProductSpace/Positive.lean (`IsSymmetricProjection.le_iff_range_le_range`, `Submodule.starProjection_le_starProjection_iff`) at that name. If `isComplProjection` is meant to be the new convention, rename the three LinearAlgebra/Projection.lean lemmas above to it in this PR, with deprecations, rather than leave the two spellings side by side.

Positive.lean compiles as the PR leaves it (as-is check: compiles true).
